quote.quote: Our sports organisers, coaches and players have worked for every trophy on this shelf — and we're aiming for more, starting with defending our Under 15 netball title next term.

hero.title: An icon for Chipinge and Manicaland, built on results.
hero.body: Kenny Technologies Group of Colleges runs two campuses — Kenny Academy Rimbi and Kenny Academy Rimai — teaching Form 1 to 6 alongside Computer Science and HEXCO courses. The same discipline shows up on the exam register and on the sports field.

story.heading: Two campuses, one standard
story.body:
Kenny Academy Rimbi and Kenny Academy Rimai operate under Kenny Technologies Group of Colleges, sharing a curriculum, a coaching structure and a director. Students move between full-time academics and competitive sport without either one being treated as the lesser priority.

That balance produced back-to-back results at the National Games: trophies in 2024, a Certificate of Excellence in 2025, and individual honours for three students recognised as best in their category.

story.heading: Financial honesty, undiminished ambition
story.body:
Not every season has gone to plan. Financial constraints kept the college from travelling to a tournament in Uganda — a setback the director has spoken about openly rather than around. It hasn't slowed the ambition: Kenny Technologies Group of Colleges is defending its Under 15 netball title next term and continuing to compete at the ASSFA Festival Tournament, where it first represented the region in 2023.

The college welcomes sponsorships and partnerships from anyone who wants to back that ambition — sports kit, travel costs, or academic equipment all move the same goal forward.

quote.quote: Kenny Technologies Group of Colleges has emerged as an icon for Chipinge and Manicaland — in sport and in academics. Every organiser, coach and player behind these results has our appreciation, and our next target is already set.
quote.attrib: Prof Caleb Simango, on the college's 2024–2025 season

cs_hexco.heading: Computer Science & HEXCO
cs_hexco.body: Every HEXCO Computer course is offered on campus, taught practically and backed by hands-on lab time — for students who want a qualification that leads directly into work, not only into the next exam.
